column1: The Automobile division contributed revenues of Kshs. 550.6M in turnover in the period under review,
compared with Kshs. 595M turnover in the previous year. The slight reduction was as a result of
reduced activity in the transport sector. The Company continues to carry out maintenance of heavy
commercial vehicles in Nairobi and Mombasa. We are looking to introduce ourselves in the E-Mobility
market by introducing a 2 wheeler to start as the whole world is moving in this direction. We are gearing
up towards setting up an assembly line at our Mlolongo Base. We will be coming out with more
information on our progress very soon.
